name: Gog
brief: A symbolic enemy of God's people in prophetic literature.
short: Gog is mentioned in the prophetic books of Ezekiel and Revelation as a symbolic enemy of God's people who will be defeated in the end times (<ref="Ezk.38.2, 3, 14, 16, 18; 39:1, 11; Revelation 20:8">Ezk.38.2, 3, 14, 16, 18; 39:1, 11; Revelation 20:8</ref>).
